owner.description: GitHub owner for bare-string repository entries (schema v4+). A string entry "repo" expands to https://github.com/<owner>/repo and auto-composes as a sub-workspace when its checkout contains a workspace manifest.

secretsDirectory.description: Gitignored directory holding per-repository local config files synced by `wspace env sync` (renamed from vaultDirectory in schema v4; default "secrets").

anyOf.description: Bare repository name; expands against the manifest's owner to https://github.com/<owner>/<name>.git (schema v4+).

url.description: Clone URL. Any Git host; bare-string expansion targets GitHub HTTPS.
